name: How often should a water softener be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How often should a water softener be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a typical water softener is generally 10 to 15 years, depending on the unit's quality, maintenance, and the hardness of your water. If your system is approaching or exceeds this age range and you're noticing a decrease in performance or an increase in repair needs, replacement is usually advisable. Regular maintenance can extend its life, but eventually, components wear out. Our team can assess your unit's condition in Surprise, Waddel, and other service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water softeners typically last 10 to 15 years. If your unit is older, shows decreased performance, or needs frequent repairs, replacement should be considered.
